summary: J&J Snack Foods filed an 8-K regarding Amendment No. 2 to its credit agreement, extending the revolving facility maturity to 2031, increasing capacity by up to $200M (or EBITDA-based amount), and raising leverage ratio covenants. No acquisition, divestiture, or special situation event is announced; this is a routine credit facility amendment. The filing includes departure of a named officer (item 5.02), but no forced departure details are provided, and terms/advisor are absent. Watch for future acquisition use of the expanded facility.
